text.title: AI Overview Presence Tracker Failure Modes
text.summary: Six antipatterns observed when applying AI Overview Presence Tracker. Each pairs symptom + root-cause + concrete fix. Detector clauses make them mechanically catchable.

antipattern.symptom: Presence rate jumps 15 points in week 4; the query list gained six new queries that week.
antipattern.root-cause: Queries added to the live set instead of to a new version.
antipattern.fix: Freeze the set per `r-fixed-versioned-query-set`; start version 2 with its own 8-week window.

antipattern.symptom: Citation rate collapses for one week and recovers; the scrape adapter logged timeouts that week.
antipattern.root-cause: Failed captures written as `aio_present: false` or `citations: []`.
antipattern.fix: Record failures as missing rows per `r-per-query-row-fields` and `r-weekly-same-day-no-interpolation`; report the reduced denominator.

antipattern.symptom: Presence rate differs sharply between two weeks; the adapter was reconfigured from mobile to desktop, or the proxy country changed.

root-cause.source: Google Search Central, AI features and your website

antipattern.root-cause: AIO availability varies by market and device; the series silently changed population.
antipattern.fix: Pin country, language, device and logged-out state per `r-fixed-locale-device-logged-out`; new series on any change.

antipattern.symptom: `our_domain_cited` true for queries whose citation list contains no URL on our domain; the snippet mentions the brand.
antipattern.root-cause: Match performed on snippet text rather than on citation host.
antipattern.fix: Match on registrable domain of citation URLs per `r-our-domain-cited-exact-host-match`.

antipattern.symptom: Finding reads "losing the citation cost us 12 percent of clicks"; Search Console has no AIO filter to support it.

root-cause.source: Google Search Console documentation (AIO traffic not separately reported)

antipattern.root-cause: Causal claim built on co-occurring series.

antipattern.symptom: Writers retrofit five pages; three of the target queries show a panel in only two of eight weeks.
antipattern.root-cause: Retrofit list built from the latest week rather than from the 8-week trend.
antipattern.fix: Apply the 5-of-8 presence and 4-week uncited filter per `r-retrofit-priority-rule`; rank by impressions.
